name: kray-core
description: KRAY-CORE — a Bitcoin-anchored, self-verifying L2. KRAY (₭) is fungible fuel with no premine and no supply ceiling: it is minted only by proof-of-burn — real satoshis provably destroyed at a keyless NUMS pay-to-contract output whose output key itself seals the network's anchor — at 1 ₭ per burned satoshi, at most 10,000 ₭ per mint, credited once per Bitcoin outpoint, and conserved as circulating = emitted − burned or the node halts. A star is born from fire: inscribing burns ₭ linearly with its bytes at the era's rate (live books: 1 ₭ per 10 KB, floor 1, 10 MB ceiling; the rate retargets every 1008 seals (one week) from measured demand, Bitcoin-difficulty style), under the Space Trinity: a 10 MB star ceiling, a hard 10 MB per-seal content budget, and a 1 MB/seal average enforced by the retarget — the atlas is bounded below the world's disks forever, and every star wears its birth cost eternally — creating a permanent, creation-numbered star; every other act pays the eternal 1-₭ fee that funds the guardians. Every act is BIP-340 signed and re-verified on replay, and the whole network commits one cascade root to Bitcoin — signature, Merkle proof, Bitcoin anchor is the only path. Capabilities: runes L2, sandboxed DeFi contracts, ordinals-origin, quantum migration. See README.md.
